column1: # The Barracks unit menu, read off a vanilla Art of Conquest game, one row per
# epoch, positions left to right. `-` is an empty position: that slot's line has
# This is observation, not derivation. Nothing in the node, its state object or
# its button holds a menu position, and intervals alone don't pin one down —
# disjoint runs admit many packings and the game's isn't the minimal one. So the
# row is written down, and tools/gen_unit_slots.py checks the running game
# against it rather than trying to work it out.
# What it settles: slot 4 runs Sampson, Viking, Hand Cannoneer, Trench Mortar,
# Heavy Mortar, and no upgrade connects any of them. A retired unit's check has
# to follow its slot, not the upgrade chain, or it stops being sendable the
# moment the next line takes the position.
